decisions.statement: A file a group writes is written by a machine rather than by an agent.
A group is named by the file property whose file that group writes.
A page type carrying a group is read from the index rather than named here.
Every page keeping a group a file property names is reached.
A page keeping no group has nothing run for it.
A group sits beside its page as that page's section named for the group.
A group writes the one file the property naming that group names.
The file a group writes is named by that property rather than by the group.
A group answering to no `bodyIn` function is said rather than refusing.
A group that breaks is said rather than refusing the landing.
A file already with the body that would be written again is left out.
A hand edit to a file a group writes is written over rather than kept.
The files are written again only where the change could turn what they hold.
A change carrying a page or a file with no ending could turn what a file holds.
A group reads the index the change leaves rather than the committed index.
A body a group writes turns where that index turns and the group's code does not.
A page moving turns every body a group composes from where that page sits.
A file no change names is written again where what a group reads turned.
Nothing here refuses a landing.
Nothing here writes a file.
No group is named here.
No page type carrying a group is named here.
A group whose code the change adds is said rather than run.
A group runs off the body the change leaves rather than off the checkout.

definition: the file a page's module property group writes beside that page
